data.text:
## Environment health by layer
Active Davis problems by entity type

data.name: Frontend
data.dql:
fetch dt.davis.problems, from: now()-2h
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| filter isNull(dt.davis.is_duplicate) or dt.davis.is_duplicate == false
| expand tipo = affected_entity_types
| filter in(tipo, {"dt.entity.application", "dt.entity.mobile_application", "dt.entity.synthetic_test", "dt.entity.http_check"})
| summarize graves = countIf(in(event.category, {"AVAILABILITY", "ERROR"})), total = count()
| fieldsAdd status = if(graves > 0, 2, else: if(total > 0, 1, else: 0))
